description: Kormsen client sites: weekly, grouped, exact pins; the Kormsen CMS and Astro move together; only @kormsen-engineering minor and patch updates merge themselves, and only on green CI.

packageRules.description: Group: one weekly PR for every non-major update.
Majors wait for approval on the Dependency Dashboard.
The Kormsen CMS edit build patches one Astro file, so @kormsen-engineering/cms-astro and astro always move together, pinned exactly.
Kormsen's own packages, minor and patch: merge when every status check passes. platformAutomerge is off, so Renovate itself waits for green CI even without branch protection.
Astro never merges by itself, even in the Kormsen CMS and Astro group (a group merges only when every update in it may).
